correctness.rationale: The coherent POVM eigenvalues are read from the full motivating paper. SU(2)-covariant CPTP maps are the convex hull of normalized rank-k Kraus channels, with exact six-j spin-1 and spin-2 multipliers verified in rational arithmetic. Since s=k(k+1) is 0 or ≥2, the facet u2−3u1+2≥0 holds for all k. Differentiation of any covariant GKSL semigroup forces γ2≤3γ1. An arbitrary hypothetical GKSL logarithm commutes with the distinct-positive-spectrum target channel, preserves each real Hermitian multipole sector, has fixed real trace from its exponential determinant, and its rotation-twirl remains GKSL with rates −ln(λL)/τ. The direct rational identity λ1³−λ2=4n/((n+2)³(n+3))>0 contradicts the bound for every n≥2. Explicit qubit GKSL generator proves the exception. Actual standalone SymPy verification passed 937 finite assertions; the analytic argument, not finite sampling, proves all spins.

value.rationale: The continuous-time realizability of repeated coherent-state monitoring is a natural open-systems question raised directly by the recent source. Showing one preferred spin-component Lindbladian differs does not decide whether a different physical memoryless bath can reproduce the channel; the theorem excludes every autonomous Lindblad bath above spin 1/2. The all-spin dipole–quadrupole witness has a quantified semiclassical decay and an attained qubit boundary, so this is a motivated structural no-go rather than a routine spectrum computation.
